$comment: The release settings of confeature/sdks, as data (#794). One home for: the publish environments and their review and admin-bypass rules, the secrets each may hold (with a rotation date), the OIDC trust bindings entered on each registry, the third-party actions any workflow may use, the protected release-tag patterns (who may create a tag that publishes), the release-shaped branch names nobody may create, the Go module tags only the sdk-publish-go deploy key may create (goModuleTags), and the mirror repositories the PHP and Swift SDKs are published through, each with its environment, tag patterns and deploy key (mirrors). The tag deployment policy of a registry environment is NOT written here: it is derived from publish[] in dagger/sdk-manifest.json (one sdk-<name>-v* pattern per unit of that registry). tools/repo-gates/verify-workflows.mjs holds the workflows to this file; the operator's tooling applies it to GitHub and reads it back.

environmentRules.requireReviewersReason: operator ruling 2026-10-16: no approval click before a publish. The gate is who may push a release tag (the release-tag ruleset: sdk-maintainers and organisation admins), the tag-only deployment policy of each environment, and the confirmation the operator gives when the tag is pushed. Turn this on the day a second maintainer joins.
environmentRules.preventSelfReviewReason: sdk-maintainers has one member today, who both tags and approves; turn this on the day a second member joins
